rationale: Single-axis structural edit on cleaning economics: drop CLEAN cost to its floor and double plaza-clean efficacy. This converts plaza maintenance from 'expensive specialist labor' (which determined the worst-off Blue's floor) into a near-free public good, guaranteeing w_p stays under bonus_threshold so Red's global harvesting keeps paying shared +bonus_value to every Blue. Hardens the assumption that the cleaner-role rotation slot is the binding constraint on the maximin Blue agent.
